_comment: What the agent may do on its own. 'auto' = done without asking, 'draft' = prepared and shown on the dashboard for a human, 'off' = never.
_createTicketComment: createTicket = tickets suggested on the Insights tab (from the AI review and the facts). 'draft' = shown with a Create in Jira button: a person checks and edits the ticket, then confirms; 'off' = shown only as suggestions. Never 'auto'.
_askFromTeamsComment: askFromTeams = Ask in the team's Teams channel (ROADMAP #9): the agent reads the channel through Microsoft Graph as one signed-in account (node agent/teams-login.mjs) and answers a message that starts with "ti:" (or @mentions it) in its thread, through the same Ask as the dashboard, masked. auto = it answers (it only answers: nothing else changes); off = it does not read the channel.
_approveFixComment: approveFix = the approval of a fix from Teams (ROADMAP #9 B, #1): under the agent's "fix ready for review" card the ticket's owner (or a name in agent.config.json teams.approvers) replies "approve" (the draft PR becomes ready for review, a Jira comment, label ai-fix-approved) or "reject: <why>" (the PR is closed with the reason, the change kept on <KEY>-rejected-<n>, and the fix runs again with the reason, at most maxFixAttempts, default 2; label ai-fix-rejected). draft = a person decides each time; off = replies are not acted on. Merging is never done: it stays a person's, in GitHub (mergeFix off).
_askActionsComment: Ask 3/7: actions under an Ask answer, each started by a person, each on the answer as the agent recorded it (never text the page sends). shareAnswer = Send to Teams: the answer, masked like the analysis (R-02), with its sources, for a person of the team the answer names or who knows its component (@mentioned). promoteFaq = Save as FAQ (K15): an answer Claude gave from the sources and a person rated right goes into docs/knowledge/faq.md through a documentation PR; the open FAQ PR collects the next ones until a person merges it (mergeDocs). Create ticket uses createTicket. draft = the button is there; off = it is not. Never auto.
_system1WarmComment: warmBySide, warmBySideThreshold (J10): while the analysis runs, a ticket whose title does not state the side ([FE], [BE]) gets a fix worktree and a warm Angular dev server; 44 of 58 warm-ups up to 2026-11-17 served no frontend fix. With System 1's side at the threshold, 'backend' = the worktree only (as for a [BE] title) and 'not code' = nothing. 'auto' = done; 'shadow' = prepared as before, the card says what would have been skipped, and after the fix stage whether that was right; 'off' = not asked. A wrong call costs time only: the fix prepares what is missing itself (a cold dev server, 20 s to 3 min). The Impact tab counts right and wrong calls; go to auto when the wrong ones stay rare.
_system1LightPathComment: lightPath (J2): a ticket whose not-code signals (type, side, and the code question) all reach lightPathThreshold. 'shadow' = shown on the card ('would take the light path'), nothing skipped; 'draft' = the ticket waits with the label ai-held and the card offers 'Light path' or 'Analyze anyway'; 'auto' = no Claude analysis, a triage comment and the label ai-triaged. Run again always gives the full analysis. Plan: two weeks of shadow with no code ticket among those it would skip, then draft.
_system1QueueComment: queueOrder (J3): 'auto' = tickets to analyze are taken by System 1's urgency (urgent, normal, low), then by age; other jobs keep their place. Set to auto on 2026-11-17: it only reorders tickets waiting together at the head of the queue, and a ticket System 1 has not answered counts as normal. 'shadow' = only an event when it would have taken another ticket first. 'off' = by age.
_system1KnownComment: knownThreshold, knownTest (J4): when System 1 names a known issue of the knowledge base at knownThreshold or more and its entry has a regression test (KB1), knownTest 'auto' runs that test on main as the next job in the queue (no model cost, a few minutes of Maven or Playwright); a failing test means the known issue may be back. 'off' = only shown.
_system1PrivacyComment: privacy, privacyThreshold (J6): on the ticket text with every name masked (the team's too), System 1 answers whether it still names a person. 'shadow' = shown on the card ('would hold'); 'auto' = the ticket gets no analysis until a person releases it on the dashboard (label ai-held), so the text never reaches a cloud model.
_system1AskReporterComment: askReporter (J7, WF1): System 1 answers what the report tells (what was done, what is wrong, where, where/when/which record). A report about code, or an unclear one, that does not tell what is wrong or where (each answer at askReporterThreshold or more) gets a question to the reporter, written from a template in the report's language: 'draft' puts it in Drafts for a person to send as a Jira comment; 'shadow' only marks the card 'would ask the reporter'; 'off' = not asked. askReporterHold: true (with 'draft') makes the analysis wait (label ai-held) until a person clicks Analyze now. Only with a checkpoint trained on these questions (questions.json).
_system1AskComment: askRouter (J5): 'auto' = an Ask question that System 1 reads as 'who knows / who worked on' a component, or 'the latest tickets', is answered from the Insights data in seconds with no Claude call, with an 'Ask Claude instead' button; 'shadow' = Claude answers and the routing is only recorded; 'off' = not asked. The fast answer needs the intent at askIntentThreshold or more and, for 'who', the component at askComponentThreshold or more: on 48 'who' questions (demo/system1/ask-components.json) ft-2 named the wrong component 8 times at 0.4, once at 0.6 and never at 0.7 (17 fast answers).
_system1Comment: System 1 (docs/SYSTEM1_PLAN.md): a local fine-tuned decision model (Laya) answers a fixed set of questions for every ticket queued for analysis (type, side, component, urgency, needs code, known issue, privacy, what the report tells), in a few seconds, on this machine. intake 'shadow' = it is asked, its answers are shown on the card and compared with the analysis after it; what they change is set per decision by the switches above (each off, shadow, draft or auto). intake 'off' = not asked, and none of those decisions run. Its answers are not given to the Claude analysis. Where the model and its Python are: agent.config.json system1.
_documentScopeComment: Which resolved tickets documentOnDone documents. 'analyzed' = only tickets the agent analyzed. 'withFix' = also bugs it did not analyze, when a commit on main names the ticket or a branch named after it holds the fix. Older ones: node agent/document-backfill.mjs.
commentHeader: (robot) *AI analysis* — automated first analysis. Please verify before acting on it.
_supersededComment: allowSupersededTestUpdates = a change request that deliberately replaces an earlier ticket's behaviour (analysis.supersedes, e.g. DEM-33 red instead of DEM-32 blue) may update ONLY the e2e tests of those tickets; the watcher checks it, and the PR, the Jira comment and the AI review call it out. false = the fix never touches tests.
_skipKnownComment: skipKnown = the analysis' 'Already known?' kinds (analysis.priorArt.kind) that get no automatic fix: a duplicate, a fix in progress on another ticket's branch, a problem fixed on main. A regression or a problem solved before in another way is still fixed (the earlier ticket's test must keep passing).
_proposeFixWhenComment: [FE] is reproduced with a Playwright test (mocked API), [BE] with a JUnit test against the real code and H2 (agent/lib/fix.mjs). A title without a tag qualifies when every file the analysis names is under frontend/ or under backend/ (inferTagFromFiles). Remove BE from titleTags to keep backend tickets analysis-only.
_regressionGuardComment: regressionGuard = every new commit on a watched main (checked every agent.config.json guardSeconds, default 120): plain code blames the lines it changes; when they were written by the fix of a resolved bug, that bug's regression tests (KB1) run on the commit, a changed regression test in its version from before the commit. An alert (a test fails, or a fix's test was changed) is posted on the commit (GitHub) and on the tickets (Jira). It never changes the code. 'off' = no guard.
_bisectComment: bisect = after the reproduction test fails on main, plain code runs it on older commits (the earlier fix of a regression, the commit before each commit the analysis names, the last commit before the suspect window; the newest that passes is the good point) and bisects to the commit that broke it, before the fix is written. No AI; a time limit (agent.config.json bisectMinutes, default 12). The result goes to the fix and review prompts, the PR, the Jira comment, and a draft assignee (the author of that change). 'off' = no bisect.
_fixComment: proposeFix = reproduce with a browser test, fix on branch <KEY>, verify independently, open a DRAFT pull request. mergeFix is always off: a human merges.
_notifyFixReadyComment: notifyFixReady (T6 of docs/GIT_GRAPH.md) = when a verified draft PR is open, a second Teams message to the person the analysis handed the ticket to, @mentioned again: the PR, what was checked, and the commit that broke it when the bisect found one. Same channel as notifyOwner (TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL); without a webhook it is shown on the dashboard only. off = the fix is seen on the dashboard, GitHub and Jira only.
_mergeCheckComment: mergeCheck (A4) = when a watched main moves, every open fix PR of the agent is checked again on the main of now: its branch merged into main in a throwaway worktree, then every backend test, the frontend build and every browser test of the sides it touches. The result is a comment on the PR. It never merges or pushes, and it waits for every other job. off = the PR keeps the checks of the main it started from.
_retryFixComment: retryFix (A3) = a fix that stopped on an accident gets one more try 30 s later: the time limit, a file held by another process (EBUSY), the network, a dev server that did not start. Never after an answer: failed checks, a bug the test did not reproduce, a rule the fix broke, a branch that exists, or a branch already pushed. off = it stops at once, as before.
_reviewComment: reviewFix = after a draft PR is opened, a second read-only agent reviews it and posts a COMMENT review with a risk level (it never approves or merges).
_emailComment: emailUpdates = mail a status update to MAIL_TO (per-user .env) at each milestone listed in agent.config.json mail.on (analysis ready, draft fix PR, fix stopped, AI review, documentation PR, failures). Needs SMTP_* settings; without them it is off and the watcher says why at start.
_documentComment: documentOnDone = when a ticket the agent analyzed moves to Done, write docs/knowledge on branch docs/<KEY> and open a DRAFT pull request.
_mergeDocsComment: mergeDocs = the documentation PRs on the Insights tab (Knowledge base). 'draft' = a Merge button; a person confirms each merge. 'off' = listed only. Only a docs/ branch that changes nothing but docs/knowledge/*.md can be merged from there. 'auto' is not used (decision 1 of docs/KNOWLEDGE_PLAN.md: a person merges until the knowledge lint has run for a few weeks without a miss) and behaves like 'draft'.
